'''Glorzo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] individual who lived around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. He collected rare technology and once owned the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] program named [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]] but according to [[Tharan Cedrax]], he disregarded the hologram's potential. When Glorzo decided to sell Holiday, both Cedrax and a [[Unidentified scavenger|scavenger]] put up offers for her so Glorzo proposed a contest between the two individuals. The buyers were to head to the [[Vaal asteroid field]], survive for more than two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] and bring back a stone from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Rukabi Major]]. The first one to succeed in this would win Holiday from Glorzo and that was Cedrax, who succeeeded days ahead of the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]].

Glorzo was considered the owner of the largest, galaxy-wide collection of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] artifacts.<ref name="Glorzo" />
